name: Spinal Cord Injury
definition: Traumatic injury to the spinal cord causing temporary or permanent motor, sensory and autonomic dysfunction below the neurological level.

typical: Respiratory compromise in high cervical injury

redFlags.item: Any suspected acute SCI is an emergency

investigations.principle: Urgent trauma imaging and specialist assessment are required.
investigations.MRI: CT assesses fractures; MRI assesses cord, disc and ligament injury.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs are secondary to modern trauma CT pathways in many settings.

green: Emergency stabilization and specialist spinal care
Early prevention of pressure injury/DVT/respiratory complications
amber: Unstable spine and cord injury contraindicate forceful manipulation or routine Panchakarma procedures.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pakshaghata/Sarvanga neurological descriptors may be used only after modern injury classification and stabilization.

patientEducation.summary: Traumatic injury to the spinal cord causing temporary or permanent motor, sensory and autonomic dysfunction below the neurological level.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
